name: Khan Dez'hepah
label: Quest
description: After The Kolkar of Desolace, Felgur Twocuts sets you against the Kolkar's leader, Khan Dez'hepah. Many centaur clans fight one another across Desolace…

clips.title: The story
paras: After The Kolkar of Desolace, Felgur Twocuts sets you against the Kolkar's leader, Khan Dez'hepah. Many centaur clans fight one another across Desolace, and Felgur wants the Kolkar disrupted before the clans unite.

The Kolkar are only one of the centaur clans of Desolace. Many roam the dry plains, fighting and dying at one another's hands. Felgur Twocuts does not mind, because the centaur are strong and brutal, and a united centaur people would be a fierce foe for the Horde. They must be dealt with before that happens.
Felgur's first move is to disrupt the Kolkar by killing their leader, Khan Dez'hepah. The Kolkar Village lies northeast of where Felgur stands, and Felgur wants the khan's head brought back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Kolkar are not the only centaur of Desolace. Many clans wander these dry plains, fighting and dying against each other. And it is good that they fight among themselves, for they are strong and brutal. If the centaur united against us, they would be a fierce foe.
We must deal with them before they unite.
Your first task is to disrupt the Kolkar clan. Do this by killing its leader, Khan Dez'hepah.
The Kolkar Village is northeast of here. Go, and may fortune go with you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, have you defeated Khan Dez'hepah?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done. This swift act against the Kolkar is an effective show of strength, and strength is what the centaur understand best.
The death of the Kolkar leader will not only disrupt that clan, but give pause to the others.
